final: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) as overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), event_avgs AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) as event_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), filtered AS (SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_avg, o.overall_avg FROM event_avgs ea, overall o WHERE ea.event_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) as mean_kept FROM filtered) SELECT f.link_to_event, ROUND(f.event_avg, 2) as event_avg, ROUND(f.event_avg - f.overall_avg, 2) as above_overall, ROUND(f.event_avg - km.mean_kept, 2) as diff_from_kept_mean FROM filtered f, kept_mean km ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10
